Game Overview

In Hoops & Fruits, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the whimsical world of Hoops & Fruits, where your hoop-tossing skills meet colorful, fruity targets. Engage in addictive drag-and-drop gameplay with charming graphics and a captivating soundtrack, challenging you to master levels and score big by hooping multiple fruits at once.
